policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

claims.label: observed
claims.text: Minnesota State win more often than any other programme Minnesota State have won nineteen, drawn three and lost two. No programme in any other conference has reached that many wins, and none in the Northern Sun has either.
claims.note: held against every other programme; the nearest is dallas-baptist at 17
